title: Defcon 20 - Dan Tentler - Drinking from the caffeine firehose we know as shodan
summary: Dan Tentler's DEF CON 20 talk on odd things he found on the internet through Shodan, such as stoplights, power systems and other non-computer devices exposed online. It highlights how many devices need no credentials.
why: HN points to it when discussing exposed IoT and industrial devices, as an eye-opening look at how much is reachable online.

quote.text: Warning - watching this may readjust your faith in humanity.
